remarks: Modern Sophistication Meets New York Grandeur! Turn-key residence at the premier luxury condo community in downtown Stamford. The Buckingham is known for its grand "NYC-Style" floorplans, ample amenities, and attentive on-site staff. This home stands out for its 2024 renovation, combining its unique and elegant floorplan with the building's iconic grand architecture, amenities and 24-hour door service. Step into a brand-new contemporary kitchen with pristine cabinetry, stone countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The attached breakfast nook just off the balcony is perfect for both casual meals and morning coffee. Stunning modern floors flow seamlessly throughout and a custom, neutral paint palette enhances the natural lighting. Enjoy a spacious open concept floorplan with a sun-filled, oversized living room and dining room designed for large gatherings. Sliders open to a private, covered balcony-ideal for enjoying sunsets, fresh air and views of a vibrant downtown. The primary bedroom suite is a spacious sanctuary featuring impressive storage, (2) walk-in closets with built-ins and an en-suite bath. Experience the convenience of a "private home" feel with the benefits of community and social acitivities. First-floor access one level above the lobby, in-unit laundry, reserved garage parking, fitness ctr., community room, garden terrace, 24-hr door service & dedicated storage units. Close to I-95, Metronorth train, Tully Health, parks, fine & casual dining, shops & more
